label: Accessible absence coverage rules out being without a source of dependence
description: Re-presentation of the dependence-to-real-impossibility premise, not independent support for it (#2103). If x depends for its being on y and could exist without y, the realization premise supplies an accessible contrast world. Coverage selects it, so soundness implies x is absent there, contradicting the witness. With the selector a free parameter, soundness and coverage hold for some selector exactly when 000e1f65 holds with being-without read as accessible contrast, CAN_BE_WITHOUT_1 (Lean track_cover_iff_strict). So the argument derives 000e1f65 from its own accessibility reading and the one-way realization bridge 11dc5069; the counterfactual selection adds no constraint unless a selector is fixed independently. Its warrant for 000e1f65 is that of the accessibility reading plus 11dc5069. The frontier counts this verified derivation as proving 000e1f65 from open premises; that computed status records no further warrant. Accessibility stays distinct from intervention outcomes, and the argument leaves the shared dependence primitive and the strict-ground map untouched.
